description: Record a mayoral tax-rate intent for the neighborhood. Mayor-only. KNOWN LIMITATION (freesoexperiment-d66): the engine-side TaxCycleHandler that would actually debit resident budgets is not yet implemented. This op validates the rate and returns ok:true with deferred:true — no §simoleons are moved, no bulletin is posted. When freesoexperiment-d66 closes, the response will include per-resident budget deltas. Until then, treat this op as a rate-intent registration only.

args.name: tax_rate_percent
args.description: Tax rate as a whole-percent of each resident's current balance (0–100). Values outside that range are refused with INVALID_TAX_RATE. Sub-percent precision was dropped when the declaration type collapsed to integer (freesoexperiment-f47).

args.name: neighborhood_id
args.description: Target neighborhood (default 1 = Alphaville on workshop). Resident list is derived from fso_roommates rows in this neighborhood.

call_signatures: cf $CF set-tax-rate --tax_rate_percent 5                                      # validated stub — returns ok:true, deferred:true; no actual debit
cf $CF set-tax-rate --tax_rate_percent 10 --neighborhood_id 1                 # explicit nhood; same stub behaviour
common_mistakes: Only the mayor (fso_avatars.mayor_nhood > 0) can call this op — non-mayor gets NO_AUTH.
tax_rate_percent must be 0–100 (integer) — INVALID_TAX_RATE is returned otherwise.
The response deferred:true means NO tax was collected — do not assume residents were debited.
No bulletin is posted by this stub — post-bulletin must be called separately if desired.
refuse_conditions: Caller is not the mayor of the target neighborhood → NO_AUTH
perception_hints: Your own mayor status: perception.avatar.mayor_nhood > 0 means you are mayor
Current balance: perception.avatar.balance (use query-self for fresh value)
Resident balances are NOT changed by this stub — query-self will not show a delta until freesoexperiment-d66 is resolved
